coverage_justification: Explicit static-stylized-v1 fixed eight views, zero turntable per batch dispatch
claim_scope: One mineralized fruiting-body fossil specimen using the preserved side silhouette, cap, stalk and shallow exposed gill relief. Do not turn it into a decorative living mushroom, add spots or an invented ring, or extend it into a complete mycelium. Preserve the corrected Gondwanagaricites magnificus name and unknown original color. Any support or unpreserved thickness is an explicitly illustrative display choice.
dimension_status: Artistic nominal overall target; measured bounds recorded separately after build, not specimen measurement
recognition_features: Compressed mineralized cap and long stalk side silhouette
Shallow exposed gill relief under cap margin
concept_decisions: Fossil lies flat on slab, not upright living mushroom. Cap width .010 m versus stalk length .034 m follows paper basic proportions. Slab and .002 m relief thickness illustrative; original color unknown. Concept B overly wide cap and upright appearance rejected.
style: Original restrained palette-only refined low-poly; broad quiet planes and diagnostic relief
intended_use: Small supporting teaching prop, 256–512px diagnostic inspection
